original.scope_and_content: Sprecher/Sprecherinnen: Bieri, Peter; Langenberger, Christiane; Ory, Gisèle

classification.source_level_rationale: The record is a direct documentation of a parliamentary debate, created at the time of the events by the Council of States.
classification.resume: This document is a parliamentary motion and its corresponding debate record from the Swiss Council of States (Ständerat) during the summer session of 2007, concerning a budget increase of 8 percent annually for the Federal Office of Culture (BFI) for the period 2008-2011. The motion was presented by the liberal-democratic group and discussed by Peter Bieri, Christiane Langenberger, and Gisèle Ory. The record is a sound recording of the debate.
